title: Two Prudential Plaza
visualBrief: Pale granite tower with blue recessed vision bays, continuous glazed central north/south strips, chevron setbacks and a diamond crown with slender spire; tall glazed Stetson lobby with reconstructed revolving doors.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X south along the long mapped axis
nativeAxes.origin: Cached tower envelope center at provisional local pavement contact

reconstruction.planBasis: Cached exact-QID ground envelope supplies scale and long-axis registration. The owner floor-28/30 plans establish north/south projections and re-entrant corners. A fourteen-bay end grid and stepped upper profiles are photographic reconstructions, not dimensioned floor polygons.
reconstruction.materialBasis: Canonical granite, stainless steel, painted metal and concrete graphs, plus reusable blue and clear PBR glazing. Every masonry joint, reveal, sill, frame, crown rib and door handle is geometry; no photographic textures or per-model image copies.

limitations: The unchanged twoPrudentialPlazaStudy.encodeAssembly reproduces the original fourteen-part instanced source master, preserved in its unchanged original recipe and local review artifact. Reviewed source and close-up retain the original granite/glass facade modules, chevron setbacks, terrace caps, clipped diamond crown and 80 ft spire, with two reconstructed revolving entrance drums replacing the four provisional swing doors and whole rectangular lobby piers replacing facade-only strips. Owner photos show revolving doors; exact counts, offsets and rotor angle are not surveyed. Street replaces masonry bay pieces with flat full wall faces and blue panes 0.14 m forward of the original reveal plane; the floor/window rhythm, central glazed end strips and every chevron step remain. District merges up to three facade rows/bays, always splitting at actual plan changes, and omits door detail; skyline averages granite/window area colors while retaining principal glazed end strips, every setback cap, diamond roof and spire. Near levels retain fifteen crown stripes; far omits roof ribs. Four shared graphs supply granite, stainless, painted metal and concrete; opaque/clear glass produces six near groups with one transparent group. No copied photo textures. Joint arrises and fine glazing divisions are omitted by the preserved original recipe despite older maximum-fidelity wording. 63 photographic office rows, 3.875 m intervals, shoulder heights and slope 1.4 are working reconstructions, not floor surveys; registry 64 floors is separate, and the contractor page has conflicting 60/68 counts. The wider One/Two Pru plaza, fountain, sculpture, shared connector, rooftop garden and neighboring tower are excluded from this tower asset. Owner upper-floor plans are undimensioned and not a complete ground survey; local grade and internal floors are approximate. Physical laptop/phone and dense-city timings remain pending.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
